blocker.message: The execution context reported foreground handle 0 while the newly owned Power BI Desktop process was responsive with title AtlynProfileLensSample. The approved guard therefore refused all keyboard, pointer, UI Automation, Save As, and close/reopen interactions.
diagnosticFallbacks: The first bounded probe established that this Desktop build omits the Power BI Desktop suffix from its window title.
The second bounded probe established foreground handle 0 and did not send input.

boundaries: No native scenario is marked passed.

Scenario outcomes are derived from fixed-schema observations. Uninstrumented field-well, profile, context, selection, tooltip, keyboard, and lifecycle scenarios are hard-coded as untrusted and cannot pass.
Future runs launch a content-addressed PBIP snapshot protected by file-share locks and directory deny ACLs; the blocked historical run predates that snapshot evidence and makes no snapshot claim.

Future runs use a suspended kill-on-close Windows Job Object, write-through crash-recovery ACL journals, a separately locked content-addressed PBIX reopen snapshot, and central/local ZIP record reconciliation; the blocked historical run predates these operational proofs.

Follow-up recovery journals are authenticated with a DPAPI-protected external HMAC key and strict contained non-reparse schemas; release PBIX bytes remain locked through evidence and manifest publication.
The exact generated fixture tree opened in the blocked launch was not contemporaneously hashed, so the current 12-page fixture is not claimed as the launched bytes.
PBIP structural generation and a responsive Desktop window are not PBIX validation.
Touch, Power BI Service publication, dashboard pinning, and Partner Center submission were not attempted.
This is not Microsoft certification, approval, or submission evidence.
